page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. No marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword or signature.

main_text.p: ca Sacerdotalis, indusium Sacerdotale, album [illegible, ~3 letters] cingulum, Zona [illegible, ~3 letters] cucullus, hac voce utitur Ritualis in ordinationibus Monachorum [illegible, ~3 letters] sunt Cancelli, quibus altare includitur, quapropter ea verba nostri Hebed Jesu de Scriptoribus Chaldæis Page 84.

[illegible, ~12 letters] [illegible, ~14 letters] [illegible, ~5 letters] [illegible, ~6 letters] ita reddimus: Ejusdem sunt capita, quæ metro decan-tantur ad portam cancellorum Accipitur quoque dictio hæc non semel pro ipso altari; particula [illegible, ~4 letters] quæ passim oc-curit in Rituali Nestorianorum, deno-tat, verba, quæ sequuntur eodem tono esse decantanda, & nequaquam mutan-dum esse tonum, uti non raro fieri solet; hinc in Rituali Maronitarum occurrit non semel verbum [illegible, ~5 letters], hoc est muta, nempe tonum; his vocibus [illegible, ~3 letters] apud Nestorianos hoc est Magnus, &

page.notes: The first word "ca" is a fragment from the previous page and stays a fragment. Long s is written as plain s throughout, and u/v and i/j are normalised. The Syriac words, including the two Syriac lines before "ita reddimus:", are not legible enough to transcribe letter by letter. Their letter counts are estimates. A stray mark "1" stands at the top left above the running head; it is not treated as printed text. "Page 84." is printed in the text itself as a page reference.
